name: Introduction and overview — B-29 Superfortress — aircraft record
title: Introduction and overview — B-29 Superfortress
description: Introduction and overview of the B-29 Superfortress: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The B-29 Superfortress is a four-engine heavy bomber built by Boeing, the most advanced bomber of World War II with pressurized crew compartments and remote-controlled gun turrets. 3,970 were built. B-29s firebombed Japan and dropped the atomic bombs from Enola Gay and Bockscar in August 1945. Baseline facts: Four-engine WWII heavy bomber; 3,970 built by Boeing; pressurized crew areas; dropped the atomic bombs..
